intention: 随时告知某人最新进展
pattern: Please keep me updated about X.
sentencePatterns: Please keep me updated about X.
I'll keep you updated as things develop.
Keep the team updated on any changes.
realLifeExamples: Please keep me updated about the CCW team when you hear from them.
I'll keep you updated on the deployment status.
usageNotes: keep + 宾语 + updated：使某人持续了解进展。职场沟通中极高频表达。可换 informed 意思相近。
